dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Nike came into the QUACC after being brought in as a stray. In the care centers, Nike has been very anxious, frequently seeking exits during her assessment and showing difficulty settling in the office while being a bit fearful. She is able to be leashed and handled by staff and will show some interest in treats. As a result, we recommend Nike is placed with one of our New Hope Partners.
dog.name: Nike
